name: Wards of the Lamp
narration: "Wear this ward," said the Jinni, "and let no blade find purchase."

name: Veil of Smoke
narration: "Wrap yourself in this smoke," the Jinni murmured, "and blows will find only shadow."

name: Scales of Brass
narration: "Alhamdulillah [praise be to God]," the Jinni said, pressing brass scales into Sinbad's palm, "wear these, and no blade shall know where you end and the ship begins."
